d: Long, wavy powder-pink hair flows down the back with long bangs framing a youthful, mature face and sharp, narrow powder-pink eyes. A slender build is draped in a flowing, sleeveless floor-length gown of pale lavender silk, featuring a deep V-neckline and a high thigh slit, layered with a vibrant crimson cape draped over the shoulders. Intricate gold chain jewelry adorns the torso, waist, and ankles, complemented by a delicate gold filigree headpiece and a matching gold ornament at the throat. The figure stands barefoot with plantigrade feet.
